reasoning: On the season so far the Suns are the stronger team; with home court the Suns start about 4 points better, in a game of about 228 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Kings.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Suns win 58 times in 100, by about 3; most games like this end between 200 and 248 total points.
